name: motiflux
description: Motiflux V1 is an AI skill that turns one supplied brand image or vector mark into source-preserving, validated, responsive logo animation.

interface.shortDescription: Turn one brand image into validated logo motion
interface.longDescription: Motiflux V1 keeps the supplied image recognizable while routing the request through 13 explicit motion themes. It produces a traceable plan, a dependency-free playable runtime, and evidence for identity, topology, timing, accessibility, and the canonical end state.
defaultPrompt: Turn this supplied image into a validated logo animation.
Route this logo-animation request to a motion theme and explain the result.
Audit this SVG animation for identity and accessibility.
